summary: New vendor data extends array degradation to 15 years. The program now requires 6 dB of link margin and a 1.2 factor on radiation dose. The baseline moves to deployable panels.

parameter_changes.name: required_margin_db
parameter_changes.rationale: Stated: this program requires 6 dB of link margin.

parameter_changes.name: dose_factor
parameter_changes.rationale: Stated: apply 1.2 to dose for solar-cycle uncertainty.

parameter_changes.name: bus_dry_mass_g
parameter_changes.rationale: Stated: bus dry mass with hinges is 3450 g.

requirement_changes.text: The downlink shall carry 1 Mbps with at least 6 dB of margin at minimum elevation.
Every part shall survive the mission dose, increased by the dose factor, with a radiation design margin of at least 2.

functions_to_revise.instruction: Add a parameter dose_factor, a ratio with default 1.0, that multiplies the mission dose before the margin is computed. Report it in the result. Keep every existing behavior when it is 1.0.

notes: The power function's method does not change. Its evidence does, so it is re-verified, not rebuilt.
The link function already takes required_margin_db, so 6 dB is an input, not a code change.
